messages.text: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

A Vector Network Analyzer fits in the AI data-center test workflow at the **signal-integrity / high-speed channel validation stages**, not as a general AI workload tester: it is used with probes, fixtures / mount-kits, switching, and de-embedding to characterize PCB traces, sockets, connectors, cables, and backplane / server interconnect channels [3][4].
| Test workflow stage | Where the VNA fits | What it measures / evaluates | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| PCB / bare-board engineering and fabrication test | During PCB interconnect probing and de-embedding for high-speed traces and transmission lines | Impedance, insertion loss, return loss, and de-embedded interconnect behavior | [2][3][4] |
| Sampling test / process monitoring flow | As part of a PCB test-flow view that complements material measurement, sampling testing, and process monitoring | High-speed interconnect quality through SI metrics such as insertion loss, return loss, impedance, and de-embedding | [4] |
| Server PCB / AI server board test | R&S ZNA / ZNB are mapped to server PCB IL and TDR tests | Insertion loss and TDR on server circuit boards / PCBs | [20][21] |
| Server motherboard / PCBA validation | R&S ZNA is mapped to server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace test | High-speed trace test on PCBA | [20][21] |
| Connector and cable validation | R&S ZNA / ZNB plus OSP are mapped to connector / cable high-speed cable testing | High-speed cable / connector channel behavior; the source does not specify cable type, connector type, or calibration method | [20][21] |
| Socket / socket-to-socket interconnect validation | Used in validation optimization and socket–socket interconnection testing | SDD12 stability proof is mentioned for 100 cycles; the complete 67 GHz topology, calibration, and de-embedding method are not specified | [2][6] |
| Board-to-board connector validation | Used with probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool for board-to-board connector testing | Connector interconnect behavior after probing / de-embedding; exact probe model and de-embedding tool name are not specified | [2] |
| ATE / inline measurement | A 4-port VNA, OSP320, flying probe module, and interposer board are listed for dual-side ATE inline measurement | Inline measurement of DUTs on test sides A/B; DUT, frequency, fixture, and calibration are not specified | [2] |
| GPU / CPU / high-speed IC context in AI infrastructure | R&S ZNA is mapped to GPU TDR and CPU / IC high-speed transmission contexts | TDR for GPU; the CPU row does not specify whether the measurement is TDR, SI, PI, or another test | [20][21] |
| Network switch / data-center networking equipment | A VNA, specifically R&S ZNA / ZNB, is mapped in the network-switch category | The source lists VNA in the switch test context but does not provide the full switching test portfolio | [21] |
| Optical / SiPh / CPO-related interconnect | Optical VNA is mapped to R&S ZNA / ZNB with partner/module combinations | Optical VNA setup is indicated, but module type and setup details are not provided | [24][25] |
【推論】For high-speed data-center interconnect products such as 112G / 224G PAM4 card-edge, backplane, direct-attached copper, OSFP / QSFP DD, and PCIe Gen 5/6 interconnects, the VNA would most naturally sit in the channel-SI validation step measuring insertion loss, return loss, impedance/TDR, and de-embedded connector/cable/PCB behavior, because the knowledge base separately identifies those interconnect product classes and data-rate labels, and separately maps VNA tools to IL, TDR, high-speed trace, cable, socket, connector, and de-embedding tests [46][47][53][54][62][63][20][21][2][4].

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › PCB material 與 insertion loss
[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出：

- 溫度與濕度升高時，[[insertion loss]] 會增加。
- Data rate 越高，loss 越高。
- [[Insertion loss]] 與 board material 有關。
- Ultra Low Loss material 在不同 data rate 下的 loss 低於 standard loss material。
- Megtron 6 等 ultra low-loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 預期比 nominal temperature 高最多 8%。
- FR4 等 higher loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 比 nominal temperature 高 11%。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Reference plane 與 vias
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signal trace 從 origination 到 termination 必須全程維持相同 GND reference。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若無法維持相同 GND reference，需 via-stitch 兩個 GND planes，以確保 continuous grounding 與 uniform impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 stitching vias 應對稱放置於 signal transition vias 50 mils center-to-center 以內，越近越好。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signals 必須 route over solid reference plane，除非絕對必要，不應跨越 plane split 或 reference plane void。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 TI 不建議 high-speed signal references 使用 power planes。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若完全無法避免 routing over a plane-split，需在 split 兩側放置 stitching capacitors，提供 high-frequency current return path；stitching capacitors 必須為 1 µF 或更低，並盡可能靠近 plane crossing。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 vias 需要 staggered placement；aligned vias 會阻擋 current return path。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 high-speed traces 只放在 top layer 或 bottom layer；若需要 vias，應考慮 back drilling，否則 stub length 可能降低 signal bandwidth。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 via transitions 造成的 stubs 若長於 15 mils，應 back-drill 以降低 insertion losses 並避免 resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe Gen5 20/80% rise/fall time 為 12 ps；為保留 12 ps rise/fall time，需要約 29 GHz bandwidth（0.35/0.12 ns rule）。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說在 29 GHz bandwidth 且使用 Megtron 6（ε 約 3.4）時，quarter wavelength 約 54 mils；若未使用 back drilling，stub 必須小於約 54 mils；對 typical FR4（ε 約 4.2）PCB，maximum stub length 約 51 mils。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Impedance 與 length matching
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 [[PCIe specification]] 要求 differential impedance 為 70 到 100 Ω。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 Add-In-Cards 為了與不同 root complexes 與 end points 互通，需要 85 Ω differential impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 85 Ω differential impedance 要求不適用於 vias、AC coupling capacitor pads、connectors、cables，但仍需注意最小化 impedance discontinuity。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 clock target impedance 為 100 Ω；maximum allowed random jitter RMS 為 200 fs，對滿足 PCIe Gen5 link EQ validation test requirements 很重要。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說不需要在不同 lanes 或 pairs 之間做 trace length matching；每個 differential pair 內嵌 clock，因此允許不同 differential trace length。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 intra-pair trace positive lead 與 negative lead 長度需控制在 5 mils 以內，以降低 common-mode noise。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Routing quick rules
[[snla426]]（June 2023）列出的 high-speed differential signal quick rules 包括：

- 不可在任何 high-speed differential signal 上放置 probe 或 test points。
- 不可將 high-speed traces route 在 crystals、oscillators、clock signal generators、switching power regulators、mounting holes、magnetic devices、board edge，或使用 / 複製 clock signals 的 ICs 下方或附近。
- BGA breakout 後，high-speed differential signals 應避開 PCIe device，因為 internal state transitions 產生的 high current transients 很難濾除。
- 盡可能將 high-speed differential pair signals route 在 PCB top layer 或 bottom layer，並搭配 adjacent GND layer。
- High-speed differential signals 與 reference plane edge 的距離需 ≥ 5×W 或 5×RPH，取較大者。
- High-speed differential signals 至少需距離 reference plane voids 4×RPH；此規則不適用於 high-speed differential signals 上 SMD pads 的 voiding。
- PCIe device BGA escape 後需維持 constant trace width，以避免 transmission lines 中的 impedance mismatches。
- 為改善 crosstalk，應遵循 ground-signal-ground signal routing，並將所有 high-speed differential pairs 對稱且平行地一起 routing。
- Package escape 與 routing 到 connector pins 時會自然偏離此要求，但 trace deviations 必須盡可能短，否則可能需要 trace width compensation。
- HFSS simulation 可用於最佳化 trace width。
- 多個 high-speed interfaces 的 devices 中，需避免不同 interfaces 間的 crosstalk。
- Package escape 後、connector termination 前，每個 differential pair 不應 route 在另一 differential pair 的 4–5×RPH mils 內。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Suggested PCB stack-ups
[[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 PCB 至少 6 layers，並列出 DS320PR1601EVM、Alternate 8-LAYER、Alternate 10-LAYER stack-up examples。來源摘要提供的 [[TI DS320PR1601 EVM]] stack-up 為：

1. High speed signal
2. Ground
3. Low speed signal
4. Power
5. Power
6. Low speed signal
7. Ground
8. High speed signal

[[snla426]]（June 2023）也指出 directly adjacent signal layers 應以 90° offset routing，且 adjacent planes 上的 traces 不應跨越 splits。

answer.text:
A Vector Network Analyzer fits in the AI data-center test workflow at the **signal-integrity / high-speed channel validation stages**, not as a general AI workload tester: it is used with probes, fixtures / mount-kits, switching, and de-embedding to characterize PCB traces, sockets, connectors, cables, and backplane / server interconnect channels [3][4].
| Test workflow stage | Where the VNA fits | What it measures / evaluates | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| PCB / bare-board engineering and fabrication test | During PCB interconnect probing and de-embedding for high-speed traces and transmission lines | Impedance, insertion loss, return loss, and de-embedded interconnect behavior | [2][3][4] |
| Sampling test / process monitoring flow | As part of a PCB test-flow view that complements material measurement, sampling testing, and process monitoring | High-speed interconnect quality through SI metrics such as insertion loss, return loss, impedance, and de-embedding | [4] |
| Server PCB / AI server board test | R&S ZNA / ZNB are mapped to server PCB IL and TDR tests | Insertion loss and TDR on server circuit boards / PCBs | [20][21] |
| Server motherboard / PCBA validation | R&S ZNA is mapped to server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace test | High-speed trace test on PCBA | [20][21] |
| Connector and cable validation | R&S ZNA / ZNB plus OSP are mapped to connector / cable high-speed cable testing | High-speed cable / connector channel behavior; the source does not specify cable type, connector type, or calibration method | [20][21] |
| Socket / socket-to-socket interconnect validation | Used in validation optimization and socket–socket interconnection testing | SDD12 stability proof is mentioned for 100 cycles; the complete 67 GHz topology, calibration, and de-embedding method are not specified | [2][6] |
| Board-to-board connector validation | Used with probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool for board-to-board connector testing | Connector interconnect behavior after probing / de-embedding; exact probe model and de-embedding tool name are not specified | [2] |
| ATE / inline measurement | A 4-port VNA, OSP320, flying probe module, and interposer board are listed for dual-side ATE inline measurement | Inline measurement of DUTs on test sides A/B; DUT, frequency, fixture, and calibration are not specified | [2] |
| GPU / CPU / high-speed IC context in AI infrastructure | R&S ZNA is mapped to GPU TDR and CPU / IC high-speed transmission contexts | TDR for GPU; the CPU row does not specify whether the measurement is TDR, SI, PI, or another test | [20][21] |
| Network switch / data-center networking equipment | A VNA, specifically R&S ZNA / ZNB, is mapped in the network-switch category | The source lists VNA in the switch test context but does not provide the full switching test portfolio | [21] |
| Optical / SiPh / CPO-related interconnect | Optical VNA is mapped to R&S ZNA / ZNB with partner/module combinations | Optical VNA setup is indicated, but module type and setup details are not provided | [24][25] |
【推論】For high-speed data-center interconnect products such as 112G / 224G PAM4 card-edge, backplane, direct-attached copper, OSFP / QSFP DD, and PCIe Gen 5/6 interconnects, the VNA would most naturally sit in the channel-SI validation step measuring insertion loss, return loss, impedance/TDR, and de-embedded connector/cable/PCB behavior, because the knowledge base separately identifies those interconnect product classes and data-rate labels, and separately maps VNA tools to IL, TDR, high-speed trace, cable, socket, connector, and de-embedding tests [46][47][53][54][62][63][20][21][2][4].
